bandlimit.rule: longitude means of products are exact when nlon > 2 m_max (m_max measured from the zeta, delta and T coefficients of the selected states)

samples.coverage: complete (all 100 nominal save days of the window, every 10 d)
samples.rule: equal-weight arithmetic mean of the selected saved states; window start < day <= end
samples.window_source: default: spinup_days < day ≤ spinup_days + n_blocks × block_days

definitions.ke: global mean of sum_k dsigma_k |V_k|^2 / 2 (m^2 s^-2)
definitions.mean_T: global mean of sum_k dsigma_k T_k (K)
definitions.weighting: ke and mean_T: Gaussian area weights times sigma-layer thickness, no local p_s factor (area- and sigma-weighted, not mass-weighted)

view.window_source: default: spinup_days < day ≤ spinup_days + n_blocks × block_days
